'''Baltor Yfridian''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who served in the [[Thaereian military]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Yfridian held the rank of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] and commanded the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Vigilant (CR90 corvette)/Legends|''Vigilant'']]. He was assigned to carry out patrols in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] and during the time of the Clone Wars, attacked a group of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] near to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]].<ref name="Who Goes Thaere" /> He later participated in the [[Battle of Cularin (21 BBY)|Battle of Cularin]].<ref name="Decision Cularin">{{LivingForce|Decision: Cularin}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Personality and traits==
Yfridian was wise and would act graciously towards those who had assisted him. He had respect for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], but despised the [[Cularin Militia]].<ref name="Who Goes Thaere" />
